chapters.reason: The paper focuses on distilling System 2 reasoning into System 1 by training models to produce high-quality outputs without intermediate reasoning tokens, effectively compressing the reasoning process.
The distillation process relies on training dynamics and supervised fine-tuning on distilled outputs rather than explicit length-based reward functions to achieve efficiency.
The paper discusses the conceptual framework of System 1 and System 2 and aims to bridge the gap between them, which aligns with the dual process theory mentioned in the System Switch category.
